program.name: Full Spectrum
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: Strength supersets, a conditioning circuit and a yoga flow, every day, for the upper body, lower body or both.
program.about: The whole spectrum in each session. Supersets train the upper body, the lower body or everything, a conditioning circuit of jumps, burpees and swings follows, and a yoga flow brings you back down. Three days rotate. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Upper / lower / full body: supersets, conditioning circuit, yoga
